_comment: Pen tool on the UR5e flange: the one place the marking node and the collision model
read the tool from (notes/pen_marking_plan.md, milestone 1). Frame: tool0, metres.
tool0 +Z points out of the flange along the pen; the camera bracket is on the side
OPPOSITE the end-effector connector. Every primitive is a CONSERVATIVE envelope of the
holder (penholder_assembly.step): correct it against the RViz markers
(tool_model_marker_node.py) and against a touch-off for the tip.
pen_tip_m: the pendant's 4-point TCP calibration IN USE, 2026-09-28, CAP OFF: (1.07, -1.35,
180.91) mm in the flange frame - keep it equal to the pendant's TCP. Before: 2026-09-25
The planner's FK is the nominal
UR5e chain; the robot's is factory-calibrated: ~3 mm apart at the tip (tcp_offset_probe
read 2.9, -0.9, 182.5 against the pendant's 0, 0, 183.78) - the known pen-side error.
holder (2026-09-29, from world/penholder_assembly.usda, axial from the flange face,
+3 mm radial margin): body flange r 45 at 55-70 mm -> holder_flange r 48; tube and
nose r 17.4 at 75-140 mm -> holder_body r 20.5 from 70 to 130 (its round cap ends at
150.5, past the 140 mm nose). Was ONE capsule r 42 to 120 (cap to 162 mm): in a 90
deg T it cleared the plates by only 1.1 mm, so square tees were unreachable.
pen capsule: its end caps are round, so p1 sits one radius short of the tip and the cap
ends AT the tip; keep p1 = pen_tip_m - radius when either changes.
camera_body: the D435i as a box in tool0 from the bench (2026-09-22): centre ~9 cm along
+y, 0 along x, body centre ~4.5 cm along z with the lens face at ~6 cm; 90 x 25 x 25 mm
plus margin, long axis along tool0 x. Correct it against the RViz markers.
camera.extrinsic_path: the hand-eye calibration (tool0 -> camera_color_optical_frame),
used for the reference marker at the calibrated optical origin, which must sit on the
lens face - if it does not, the calibration is off and the whole pipeline inherits it.
